own_solution.law: F = (1 + R) I A cos^2(theta)/c along the normal; v = F t/m
assumptions: rail normal to mirror takes no tangential force; v << c

defect_reasons.other: TFEB0 says the lamp adds intensity to 'the light that reaches the mirror' without saying it enters the beam or lasts the whole exposure; the problem's clause on lamp light put into the beam makes the intended reading (along the beam, throughout) the natural one.
